name: Proposal for a decision
title: REPORT on the request for the waiver of the immunity of Nikos Pappas
part_text:
The European Parliament has decided to lift the legal protection that Nikos Pappas, a Greek member of the European Parliament, holds as an elected representative. This means Greek prosecutors can now take him to court over a complaint that he insulted and defamed a journalist during an online interview in March 2024. The protection exists to shield members from being targeted for their political work. Parliament found no sign that this case is being used to harm his political activity.

- Greek prosecutors can now prosecute Nikos Pappas over the 2024 interview complaint.
- It affects Nikos Pappas, a Greek member of the European Parliament.
- Parliament's President sends the decision to the Greek authorities and to Pappas.
